comparison: Nested 100MB to 1GB background; fixed original train/validation labels, K=8, W=unlimited, alpha=kappa=lambda=eta=1, rho=.001; same threshold grid and paired document bootstrap
sampling: Same pinned FineWeb revision and four shards; retain all 100MB background, sample new row groups/rows, then length-stratified selection
storage: Whole-document blocks preserve every context and outcome count on disk; load exact sums only for all contexts queried by fixed train/validation prefixes; no model approximation. Do not interpret projected-load timing as general inference speed.
heldout: Raw heldout text only for duplicate exclusion; no heldout labels or scores; no new teacher inference
